shopify.title: Remy everyday bag
shopify.descriptionHtml:
Remy pairs stitched detailing with a simple everyday silhouette. Its clasp detail and internal compartments keep the design practical, with dedicated places for a phone, cards and smaller items.

  • Stitched exterior detailing
  • Clasp detail
  • Internal phone, card and zippered pockets
shopify.shortDescription: Remy pairs stitched detailing with a simple everyday silhouette. Its clasp detail and internal compartments keep the design practical, with dedicated places for a phone, cards and smaller items.
